title: Plumeform dark band
description: A full-bleed section in near-black green with a backdrop slot (art or video) that fades in as the band scrolls into view; empty, it shows a soft teal glow. Tells the plumeform header to turn dark over it.
notes: forces the dark colours by default (tone="inherit" to follow the page)
the original's WebGL fluted glass is not rebuilt: pass your own art as backdrop
